**Design note.** The task model is a trustee following a five-step argument: proposal → survey signal → evidence gap → cost and staffing → authorization and review. Claims stay beside their limits; numbered navigation supports interruption and return. The pacing targets roughly 18 seconds per slide. A warm-paper, library-editorial direction uses large serif assertions, proportional time bands, and restrained color to distinguish observed evidence from proposed hours. Phone layouts reflow rather than shrink the slides.
